blocks.text: I, **{{worker.full_name_caps}}**, residing at {{worker.address_inline}}, hereby affirm and declare as follows:

items: I have been offered the role of {{role.title}} with {{company.legal_name}}, starting on {{employment.start_date_long}}.
I will devote my full working time and attention to {{company.legal_name}}.
I will not take up any other employment, consultancy or business activity without the Company's prior written approval.
I understand that a breach of this affidavit is a breach of my terms of engagement.
I understand that a breach may lead to action under the Company's disciplinary procedure.
I certify that, apart from the activities I list in Schedule A, I have no other employment, consultancy or business activity.
I will tell the Company promptly about any change to the statements in this affidavit.
I understand that this affidavit is legally binding.
I make this affidavit believing its contents to be true.

blocks.text: I complete Schedule A when I sign this affidavit. It lists every outside activity, paid or unpaid, or confirms that I have none, and forms part of this affidavit.
Sworn and declared before me on this ______ day of ____________, 20____, by {{worker.full_name_caps}}.

items: **Submission deadline:** submit this affidavit within {{company.affidavit_hours}} hours of receiving the offer letter.
